views.front: The body and lid now read as smooth turned forms, with a visibly open pouring spout.
views.rear: The timber handle, original base and retained controls remain attached from the opposite side.
views.detail: Full detail confirms a rounded annular lip with a recessed bore and small grip ribs aligned around the actual vertical knob.
views.underside: The base remains closed, the level scale is preserved, and the spout has a coherent thin-wall opening.
views.clay: Clay confirms the open outlet and smooth body silhouette; the inherited straight timber handle remains a simplified source detail.
